text: Customers may request a full refund within 30 days of purchase. Refunds are issued to the original payment method within 5 business days. Opened hardware is subject to a 15 percent restocking fee.
Standard shipping takes 4 to 6 business days within the continental United States. Express shipping arrives in 2 business days and costs 18 dollars. Orders over 75 dollars qualify for free shipping.
Every Lumen sensor includes a two year limited warranty covering manufacturing defects. The warranty does not cover water damage or physical abuse. Warranty claims require the device serial number.

The support team is available Monday through Friday from 8 am to 6 pm Central Time. Priority support customers can reach an on-call engineer 24 hours a day. The average first response time is under 2 hours.
All customer data is encrypted at rest with AES-256. Data in transit is protected with TLS 1.3. Access to production systems requires hardware security keys.
The Lumen sensor measures temperature, humidity, and air quality every 60 seconds. The Lumen battery lasts up to 18 months on a single charge. The sensor connects over Wi-Fi or Thread.
The Starter plan costs 9 dollars per month and supports up to 5 sensors. The Team plan costs 49 dollars per month and supports up to 50 sensors. Enterprise pricing is negotiated annually.
Raw sensor readings are retained for 13 months. Aggregated hourly summaries are retained indefinitely. Customers can export their data as CSV at any time.
